# Check It Out — influencer-marketing platform & CodeMap AI navigator

> Check It Out connects local businesses with influencers (campaigns,
> applications, cooperations, subscriptions). The same team ships CodeMap:
> a graph-navigator AI that answers questions about this 430k-LOC codebase
> with a 4B local model on a plain CPU — grounded, honest, offline — and a
> consent-gated Claude API escalation tier.

## Pages

- [Landing](https://checkitout.app/): product overview, pricing, FAQ, team
- [CodeMap & AI](https://checkitout.app/codemap): the AI application — replay
  real recorded navigation sessions, the training journey (0/20 closed-book
  to 0.9752 with abstention 1.0), architectural decisions, install guide
- [Technical survey](https://checkitout.app/technical-survey): the platform's
  README written to be read — five chapters with real code and honest numbers

## Source & research

- [graph-theory-system-modeling](https://github.com/Check-It-Out-Dev/graph-theory-system-modeling):
  the NavigationMaster mathematics + CodeMap application (MIT, end to end)
- [checkitout-frontend](https://github.com/Check-It-Out-Dev/checkitout-frontend): this frontend
- [checkitout-backend](https://github.com/Check-It-Out-Dev/checkitout-backend): the Spring Boot backend
